artboards.title: Direction C · dense operator console (not chosen)

annotations.text:
Sonder redesign · quiet instrument
The transcript is the object; chrome is hairlines and a 24px glyph gutter (❯ you, ◈ sonder, ▸ tool, ⊘ refused). One accent: Sonder's own signal teal #63D6C8 on the existing #0B1117 canvas. IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for the transcript, status and terminal. Dark first, light mirrored. Static mockups: nothing here is wired.

App: left rail 272px (threads, projects, quick actions), reading column 760px, activity drawer 320px on wide screens, 28px status bar. A refusal is a card with the three real remedies; the mode chip lives in the composer.

Terminal: keeps the pinned contracts (the Sonder · answer label, the ╰ 1.20s (/pass or /fail) footer, the ◈ Sonder is working... line, byte-exact piped output) and restyles around them: the box banner becomes a two-line header, gutter glyphs, tool rows, a refusal that names /approve, status right-aligned on the prompt line. ASCII fallbacks for every glyph.
Two other directions, sketched low-fi so the choice is about structure. Neither was built out; the committed direction above is the deliverable. Say the word and either becomes the main line.
